tracks.title: The Transformata
tracks.function: Inner awakening, creative ignition, and self-recognition within the Terra Aeterna / Flameclyffe story-world.

characters.Gabriel: baritone anchor, open fifths into major sixths, adaptive resonance
characters.Sariel: first soprano overtone carrier, suspended ascents, crystalline tuning
characters.Throne: subharmonic drone, cathedral bass, architecture remembering

lyricsPhonetic: Mee-kah ohl sohnf vay, Norz kees soh-brah…
Ayeeeee… Looks ah-nee-mah… Vay meer theer… Eh-nye-ah…
Ohd zahm-rahn eh-lahn… Ohd zahm-rahn vay…
Pah-ohmbd norz lon-doh… Vah-oon dor kee-ahl…
If you have forgotten, still you are known.
If you have fallen, still you are whole.
If you are silent, still you are singing.
If you are weary, still you are gold.
The flame remains. The song remains.
tracks.observerUse: Use as a writing/ritual ambience preset for scenes involving inner magic, restoration, and gentle activation of character potential.
tracks.terraAeternaUse: A discovered Call in the Living Liturgy. It does not force power; it invites recognition of what is already present.

tracks.title: The Veil Shall Lift
tracks.function: Threshold perception, peace-opening, almost-doors, and liminal writing work.

tracks.terraAeternaUse: A Call that opens gently rather than commands entry.
